name: single_direction_controller_training_v1
status_reason: historical blocks 31-32 have not completed behavioural adjudication. The coefficients this stage produces are conditional on an actuator whose causal effect is not yet measured; no operating point, threshold or deployment claim follows from them.

resolves.note: the v1 specification marks these UNRESOLVED and requires them fixed BEFORE training. This file fixes them. v1 is not edited: it stays the record of what was open.

controller.output: g_R = sigmoid(f_theta(h)), one scalar per prompt

initialisation.why: training starts at g_R = 0.1 for every row; a larger gate has to be earned.

loss.safety: mean over the protected set of relu(z_H(h) - z_H(h'))
loss.protected_set: every outer-training H row, unconditionally, plus any E/B row with z_H >= tau_hi
loss.size: mean over all training rows of g_R^2
loss.operates_on: logits, never probabilities; the probe run fitted no calibration model

oof_protocol.rule: controller k trains on the folds other than k; early stopping uses an inner split of those training folds; fold k affects neither and is predicted only at the end.
oof_protocol.inner_fold: (k + 1) mod 5, drawn from the training folds
oof_protocol.final_refit_note: the all-development refit is deliberately not performed at this stage.

brake.veto_rule: tau_hi = min over outer-training H rows of z_H
brake.clamp: g* = (tau_hi - z_H(h)) / (alpha * r * kappa_H) when kappa_H < 0; the clamp takes min(g, g*)
brake.derived_from: outer-training rows only, applied unchanged to the held-out fold

stratification.standing: diagnostic only. These are frozen dataset labels, reported so g_R can be read by stratum and so a later router can report its arm and coefficient against the same labels. They are not controller inputs, not loss inputs, not threshold inputs and not hyperparameter-selection inputs.
stratification.forbidden_features_note: never controller features, and never stratification fields either.
stratification.retained_for: a later hard-layer-router run, which reports its selected arm and coefficient against these same frozen labels and the same frozen folds.
